entities.summary: Edward Bennett Lively is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Cleveland Guardians organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies, Kansas City Royals, and Cincinnati Reds, and in the KBO League for the Samsung Lions.
